scope.historicalCaveat: Channel 010 retains 132 logical row/bit positions, but only 120 are populated by physical latching relay packages. Physical fidelity is defined by docs/physical-relay-inventory.json.

routeDefinitions.MECH-ONLY: Identity/timing/audio/haptic still run through `relay-identity-audio.js` + `relay-visual-coupling.js`; `projectRelayWord` intentionally has no visible consumer for this bit/bank.
routeDefinitions.NO-PHYSICAL-RELAY: Logical Channel 010 state only. No physical relay/contact event, manufacturing profile, click, or haptic.
routeDefinitions.AUX-EXTERNAL: Real non-latching relay sourced from AGC command or yaAGC hardware-phase state; contact affects an external spacecraft indication rather than a DSKY face lamp.
